\section[lavō, lavāre]{lavō, lavāre — to wash}

\label{lesson:LA-C76-lavo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Latin for to laugh, then the Latin for to weep.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: lavō, lavāre}
\textbf{lavō, lavāre} — \textquotedblleft{}to wash\textquotedblright{}. English \emph{lavatory}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for wash, cook, sell, swim, call.
\end{grammarlens}

\end{itemize}
